native_options_review.comparison: On this boot, 64-request default and prefix_match_unit=16 stock runs both cached 129360 tokens; duration 36.7674 vs 36.9573 seconds. Keep default; this is a bounded applicability check, not proof of a globally optimal baseline.
native_options_review.not_applicable: mamba all mode rejected by Qwen3.5; fine-grained mamba cache needs speculative EAGLE, disabled in fixed protocol.

rate_choice_reason: 4 requests/s reaches client 16 and server 16 on moderate/roomy, with sampled server queue up to 9. Use the same arrival sequence/rate for both policies; report client-side admission delay as well.
note: All selected calibration runs are from the same current GPU UUID. Earlier boot runs are retained as diagnostics, excluded from the lock.
